case_name: Sukhjinder Pal Singh vs State Of Punjab & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Punjab and another — wife

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage dispute between the parties. FIR registered against the petitioner under Sections 498-A, 406, 506 IPC. Parties amicably resolved their disputes and filed a petition for quashing of the FIR.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be allowed to make mockery of the Court proceedings nor ignore the statement made by them in the Court.
legal_principles.held: Respondent No. 2 cannot be allowed to make mockery of the Court proceedings, nor the statement made by her in the Court can be ignored.
cited_cases: Sukhjinder Pal Singh vs State Of Punjab & Anr on 9 January, 2018

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be allowed to back out from the compromise or wriggle out of the statement made before the court after having benefitted from it.
legal_principles.held: After having benefitted and taken maintenance under the compromise, she cannot be allowed to back out from the compromise or to wriggle out of the statement made before the court.
cited_cases: Sukhjinder Pal Singh vs State Of Punjab & Anr on 9 January, 2018

legal_principles.principle: A party's statement before the court must be honoured and not ignored.
legal_principles.held: Respondent No. 2 cannot be allowed to act in a manner and take benefit under the compromise to the extent she stands benefited.
cited_cases: Sukhjinder Pal Singh vs State Of Punjab & Anr on 9 January, 2018

outcome.final_order: The writ petition stands allowed and the FIR No. 336 dated 15.08.2009 is hereby quashed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
